facts.text: Jon is still working on the dance studio and things are looking up.

evidence.quote: Hi! Since we last spoke I am still working on the dance studio and things are looking up!

facts.text: Jon attributes losing his job as the push to start his dream business, which is his own dance studio.

evidence.quote: Losing my job gave me the push to finally start my dream business: my own dance studio!

facts.text: Jon acknowledges that stepping into the unknown is scary but remains hopeful for the future of his dance studio.

evidence.quote: Now I'm stepping into the unknown and hoping for the best.
It must be scary stepping into the unknown but I know you can do it, Jon.

facts.text: Jon mentions that dance is his stress-buster since childhood.

evidence.quote: It's been my stress-buster since childhood!
